name: github-timesheet
description: Reconstructs a PinkRoccade 'Uren' timesheet from real calendar + GitHub-Enterprise signals. Serves a live HTML view and downloadable .xlsx.

modules.src/timesheet/config.py: Config dataclass with all tunable knobs; Config.from_env() reads env vars
modules.src/timesheet/model.py: Shared data types: Meeting, FullDayEvent, Commit, Block, Day
modules.src/timesheet/periods.py: Period resolution helpers (this-week, last-week, this-month, last-month, custom)
modules.src/timesheet/pipeline.py: collect_week() and build_from_ingest(): orchestrates collectors → reconstruct
modules.src/timesheet/reconstruct.py: Core reconstruction logic: produces list[Block] for a single day
modules.src/timesheet/demo.py: Offline demo from a fixture JSON file
modules.src/timesheet/run.py: CLI: one-shot live reconstruction + optional email delivery
modules.src/timesheet/collectors/ghe_authored.py: PRs opened + issues authored (GHE search API)
modules.src/timesheet/collectors/ghe_reviews.py: PR reviews (per-PR REST fan-out, background only)
modules.src/timesheet/render/xlsx.py: openpyxl writer for the manager's exact column template
modules.src/timesheet/service/main.py: FastAPI app: GET /, GET /uren.xlsx, POST /api/ingest, GET /status, GET /healthz
modules.src/timesheet/service/security.py: Ingest token check + signed download-link verify

tests.notes: All tests run offline against fixtures; no network calls

important_invariants: RECONSTRUCT_VERSION in config.py must be bumped with a comment whenever reconstruction logic changes — used as a cache-bust key by the store
The service never calls GHE on a cached page view; GHE is only hit on a cache-miss or nightly CronJob
All-day calendar events marked busy/oof own their whole day and are reported as Verlof, not reconstructed
AI label polish (LiteLLM) runs only in the background refresh (run.py), never in a web request
Current (in-progress) week is always rebuilt live and never cached
